evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/lib/api.ts:258 (configureApiClient) is NEVER called in production code. A repo-wide grep for `configureApiClient(` finds hits only in lib/api.test.tsx (7 test calls) and the docstring — no call in main.tsx / App.tsx / AuthProvider or any provider. Consequently the singleton created by getApiClient() (api.ts:233-238) is built by createAxiosInstance({}) with config.getToken === undefined, so module-level `tokenGetter` (api.ts:138) stays undefined and the request interceptor's `if (tokenGetter)` guard (api.ts:162) is ALWAYS false -> no Authorization: Bearer header is ever attached. onUnauthorizedCallback is likewise undefined, so the 401 branch (api.ts:180) is dead.

This client is not dead code: it backs two shipped, routed features. usePredictiveMaintenance.ts:33/50/63/76 and useSentiment.ts:35/53/69/82/93/108 call getApiClient().get/post/put against authenticated endpoints, and both are mounted under the AI Dashboards route group (routes/groups/ai-dashboards.tsx — Sentiment 13.2 + Predictive Maintenance 13.3). Every request from these dashboards therefore goes out with no JWT and is rejected 401 by api-server, with no logout/refresh handling. The token-injection + unauthorized interceptors — and their whole test suite in api.test.tsx that passes getToken/onUnauthorized explicitly — never exercise the wiring the app actually runs. Fix: call configureApiClient({ getToken: getAccessToken, onUnauthorized }) during AuthProvider init (mirroring setTokenProvider for @ppt/api-client at AuthContext.tsx:325), or route these hooks through @ppt/api-client which already has the global token provider.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/lib/api.ts:174-212 — the response interceptor auto-retries (up to MAX_RETRIES=3) whenever isRetryableError() is true, and isRetryableError (api.ts:85-93) returns true for EVERY network error (no response) plus 5xx/408/429, with NO check on config.method. It calls instance.request(config) again regardless of verb, so a POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE that the server actually processed but whose response was lost to a network blip or 502/504 is silently replayed. On non-idempotent mutation endpoints reachable through this client (e.g. useSentiment acknowledge-alert POST / update-thresholds PUT at useSentiment.ts:93/108, and any future getApiClient() POST) this causes duplicate side-effects. Safer: gate retries to idempotent methods (GET/HEAD/PUT/DELETE per spec, or an explicit idempotency-key allowlist) and never blind-retry POST on a no-response error.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/lib/errorHandler.ts:53-141 — the entire ERROR_MESSAGES catalog (Authentication Required, Invalid Credentials, Session Expired, Access Denied, Rate Limit Exceeded, Server Error, You are Offline, ...) and DEFAULT_ERROR are hardcoded English string literals rendered to end users via parseApiError()/parseHttpStatusError(), none wrapped in react-i18next t(). ppt-web ships react-i18next (react-i18next 16 per root CLAUDE.md), so this central error-display path is English-only regardless of the user's locale. formatFieldName() (errorHandler.ts:454-464) similarly Title-Cases raw field keys instead of resolving localized labels. Low severity but a wide, systematic i18n gap in a core module; the fix is to key the catalog and translate at render time.
